top_categories.workout_context: 60ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Wörthersee Gravel Race's Carinthian lake country, Alpine foothills forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 93 miles.
At Wörthersee Gravel Race, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Wörthersee Gravel Race's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Wörthersee Gravel Race. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
5,620ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
5,620ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Wörthersee Gravel Race, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 93 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on carinthian lake and river gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Wörthersee Gravel Race’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Wörthersee Gravel Race requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on carinthian lake and river gravel to build confidence. Expect: carinthian lake country, alpine foothills, drau river gravel.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Gravel Specific, and Over Under to prepare you for 93 miles of carinthian lake and river gravel in Velden am Wörthersee, Austria.
